maya: CI is red on PR #2321 — only failing on matrix axis postgres-12, test 'sql-connector::connection_timeout' timing out after 30s. Link: <https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/12345|run/12345>
ci-bot: Workflow run 12345 · integrations · failed — job sql-connector-postgres-12 (job_id: 9876)
maya: Anyone around to trigger a targeted retry? Don't want a full image rebuild; this is flaky.
sam: You can rerun only that job without rebuilding the image. Two quick options:
1) GitHub CLI approach:
```
 gh api -X POST /repos/<org>/<repo>/actions/runs/12345/rerun -f job_ids='[9876]'
```
2) Our internal ci helper (preferred):
```
 ci retry --run 12345 --job sql-connector-postgres-12 --no-image-build
```
sam: If you don't have the job_id, `gh run view 12345 --json jobs` will show them.
jordan: For matrix axes we usually do `--axis postgres=12` with the helper, e.g.
```
 ci retry --pr 2321 --axis postgres=12 --preserve-volume
```
jordan: That keeps cached layers, avoids rebuild, and only reruns the failing axis.
lee: If it keeps flaking, add `--repeat 3 --delay 10s` to auto-retry the same job a few times before escalating.
maya: Running the internal helper now: `ci retry --run 12345 --job sql-connector-postgres-12 --no-image-build`
maya: Done — kicked off run 12346 (retry). Thanks :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Workflow run 12346 · integrations · queued
sam: ping me if it fails again, I can bisect the changelist locally or run with `CI_DEBUG=1` to collect extra traces.
maya: Update: retry succeeded, tests passed, PR is green. Marking as resolved :tada:
lee: Nice, thanks for the quick triage :rocket:
